incidents.name: DKP exchange spot-price manipulation
incidents.notes: The closed-source DKP exchange prices USDT-to-DKP swaps from the USDT/DKP pair's live reserve ratio, so a flash loan skewed that ratio and let the attacker buy DKP for almost nothing and sell it back.

sources.ref: onchain review: DKP exchange 0x89257A52Ad585Aacb1137fCc8abbD03a963B9683 created 2023-03-03T05:21:53Z by 0xc18d159aaa01a05682d4a93dd153b6877cfc9d4e, unrelated to attack sender 0xf38b677fa6e9e51338d0c32fd21afe43406e06df; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain across the two attack transactions: 774.41 USDT in this one and 79,233.96 USDT in 0x2d31e45dce58572a99c51357164dc5283ff0c02d609250df1e6f4248bd62ee01, totalling 79,908 USDT (DeFiHackLabs reports ~$80K). Boundary row: the exchange behaved as coded and the attacker moved the price it read.
